blocks.text: Event Experience Expo (E3) 2026 is gaining strong industry support as companies from across the MICE sector come on board as official partners and sponsors of the two-day expo in October at World Trade Center Metro Manila. The growing roster spans event technology, production, audiovisual solutions, staging, exhibition build, logistics, creative services, F&B, and other event-related specialties, giving E3 a broad representation of the companies that help bring events from planning to execution. “Events today must do more than bring people together. They must create meaningful connections, enable business and continuously respond to how technology and customer expectations are changing,” said […]...
